author: Hippojaw
quote: Most overhyped game of all time. Rockstar lost the plot. Selling cases with license codes and not disc. Terrible single player practices, 80 for base 20 more dollars for access to all building and another 7 dollar monthly subscription for exclusive cars and discounts on in-game purchases. Critics seem to be bought and this game is the best example just go read a few of the reviews, we crucified games for less technical difficulties then this game. 30 fps on the most powerful console and no option to turn off game settings for a better and smoother experience on release. As a consumer this is ridiculous and not for us. With some updates I'm sure the game will become a more finished product. Instead of saying "it was worth the wait" we should be speaking with our wallets keep waiting for a full product as of right now we were sold promises. no rockstar we didn't forget how you treated RDR2 online. Hope it was worth it  rockstar. We don't give free 10s for trash practices.
